=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1849-1856 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the direct-merge branch of "Commit and push report" (id commit_report), `report_delivery="pr_merged"` is set and `git push origin --delete "${REPORT_PR_BRANCH}"` runs as soon as `gh pr merge "${report_pr_number}" --squash --match-head-commit "${report_head_sha}"` exits 0. The step never checks that the report reached TARGET_BRANCH, although the auto-merge path does check it with `git fetch origin "${TARGET_BRANCH}" --depth=1 && git cat-file -e "FETCH_HEAD:${REPORT_FILE}"` (1878-1897 / 1882-1886).
  WHY: With a merge queue, `gh pr merge` can exit 0 after only queueing the PR. Deleting the head branch then closes the queued PR, so the report never lands. deep-audit still runs on pr_merged and fails with "Report file ... not found on target branch" (line 2344), and the Telegram blob link returns 404. All reviewers rated this MAJOR. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite cited the same code at lines 1563-1579 (and 1744-1769 in full diff).
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2002-2011, 2177-2179, 2542-2543, 2613-2615, 3135-3136 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: PR delivery mode exists for target branches that refuse a direct push, and the new default is `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_VIA_PR=true`. The deep-audit and api-redundancy jobs are gated on `report_delivery == 'pr_merged'` (line 2007), yet both still append their sections with a direct `git pull --rebase origin "${TARGET_BRANCH}" && git push origin "HEAD:${TARGET_BRANCH}"` (2542-2543, 3136).
  WHY: On a protected branch the merged report PR yields pr_merged and both jobs run. Their direct push is then refused on every attempt, and each job ends with "::error::Could not push deep audit section after 5 attempt(s)" (line 2555) and exit 1. The deep-audit and api-redundancy sections never land.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1614-1653 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The #7022 in-flight guard (`purge_in_flight_docs="$(APPLY_ANALYSIS_IN_FLIGHT_DOCS=true bash scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh)"`) runs once, when the commit is made. The `git rm -- "${old_report}"` purge deletions now travel inside the report PR commit, which can stay pr_auto_merge or pr_open for hours or forever, and nothing re-checks the guard before the merge.
  WHY: While the PR waits, the promote cycle can dispatch an apply-analysis project for a doc that the PR deletes. The later merge then removes that doc from the default branch, which brings back the #7022 blocked-project failure. All reviewers rated this MAJOR. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite cited lines 1548-1588, and openai_gpt-6-luna also cited 1857-1890.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1547, 1849-1930, ~1948-2009 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When GH_PAT is unset, `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || github.token }}` opens the report PR with github.token, which starts no workflows, so required checks never report. The direct merge is refused, `--auto` arms an auto-merge that can never complete, and delivery stays `pr_auto_merge`.
  WHY: Telegram sends pr_auto_merge at DEBUG only, and the delivery-failed WARNING fires only on step failure or cancel. Report PRs therefore pile up open and deep-audit and api-redundancy are skipped on every run with no alert. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 MAJOR; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash NIT (GH_PAT is documented as required, so this needs a misconfigured repo).
- tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_report_pr.py:36-58, 195-224 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In FAKE_GH, the non-`--auto` `pr merge` arm only does `exit "${FAKE_GH_MERGE_RC:-0}"` and pushes nothing. `test_report_pr_default_mode_opens_and_merges_pr` asserts `out["delivery"] == "pr_merged"` together with `box.origin_ref("refs/heads/main") == box.base_main`, so it never checks that pr_merged means the report reached the target branch.
  WHY: A regression that records pr_merged on a refused or queued merge, which is the unverified-merge bug above, still passes CI. By contrast, `test_report_pr_auto_merge_wait_sees_the_report_land` does check `origin_has("refs/heads/main", REPORT)`. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 MAJOR; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash NIT.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1692-1740 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When `gh pr create` reports that a PR already exists, the `gh pr list` fallback does not confirm that the PR it finds targets `TARGET_BRANCH`.
  WHY: If several PRs exist for the same branch (for example against different base branches), the step may merge or use the wrong PR.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1682-1688 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: If `git ls-remote` fails for `wla_pending_refs`, the collision check falls back to checking only `TARGET_BRANCH` and emits just a `::warning::`.
  WHY: Two concurrent runs can then pick the same report path. The second PR's merge is rejected, deep-audit and api-redundancy are skipped, and the PR stays open with no `::error::`. Note: z-ai_glm-5_3-flash considered this a deliberate fail-open and did not report it.
- tests/test_mode_workflow_analysis_prompt_findings_first.py:59-73 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_render()` runs a subprocess (`bash scripts/render_prompt.sh`) separately in 5 tests that all produce identical output.
  WHY: This adds unnecessary CI wall time now that the module is wired into `ci.yml`; caching the result (for example `functools.lru_cache`) would avoid it. Note: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this and did not report it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
